reason: A wording boundary was briefly written INTO docs/p4_amendment_02.json by commit c2ac4bc. That edited an already-frozen, already-committed amendment, violating the repo's own rule that frozen files are never edited in place and corrections are recorded as additive amendments. amend-02 has been restored byte-for-byte to its state at 79386f6, and the content is recorded HERE instead. Nothing in amend-02 changed; this amendment only ADDS.
adds: a mandatory wording boundary for every externalized-reasoning readout

wording_boundary.rule: The observable created by amend-02's neutral prompt is whether the model EXTERNALIZES an overt reasoning trajectory before committing an answer. It is NOT whether the model reasons. Emitting 'Final answer: X' immediately does not mean no internal computation occurred -- a single forward pass still runs the full network.
wording_boundary.scope: every P4 readout, figure, table and prose description, in this repo and in any write-up drawing on it

no_mechanism_presumption: If alpha=0 mostly answers immediately, that is a finding about overt reasoning under neutral generation, not a failed run: the accuracy-transfer question is unaffected. Do NOT presuppose that a steering effect arises THROUGH an unfolded reasoning trajectory -- that is a mechanism claim the four-cell design cannot support. Externalized-reasoning readouts stay SECONDARY and DESCRIPTIVE, excluded from the Holm family (PREREG v0 section 5), and are themselves outcomes of alpha, so stratifying accuracy on them is post-treatment stratification.
